blocks.text: Hydrocarbons qudrati taur par kai processes se bante hain, jaise paude (vegetation), jangal ki aag (wildfire), volcano aur zameen se tel ya gas ka rasna (seeps). Anthropogenic (insani) activities, jaise fossil fuels ka incomplete jalna, tel ka girna (oil spills), aur factories aur gariyon ka dhuan (emission), bhi hydrocarbons ke sources hain. Automobiles (gariyan) hydrocarbons ka sab se bara source hain. Methane sab se aam hydrocarbon aur air pollutant hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrocarbons ke natural aur insani sources, aur sab se aam hydrocarbon pollutant batayein.
blocks.explanation: Natural: paude, jangal ki aag, volcano aur tel ya gas ka qudrati rasna. Insani: fossil fuels ka incomplete jalna, oil spills, factories aur sab se barh kar gariyon ka dhuan. Sab se aam hydrocarbon methane hai.

items: Hydrocarbons: paude, wildfire, volcano, seeps (natural); incomplete jalna, oil spills, factories, gariyan (insani, sab se bara); methane sab se aam.
